presentation: [Elite Demon] Estarossa of [b]Love[/b] taunts enemies with his stance skill and counters incoming attacks, making it difficult for the enemy to use attack skills.

passif.description:
For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Demon ally[-] participating in battle, their basic stats increase by [FFAE00]6%[-] and the hero's Ultimate Move Gauge increases by [FFAE00]1 orb[-].

When an ally uses a Stance Skill, they have all of their Debuff effects removed and gain [00D5FF]Debuff Immunity[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-]. When a [00D5FF]Demon ally[-] uses a Stance Skill, [00D5FF]Dark Veil[-] is additionally granted for [FFAE00]1 turn[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Dark Veil: Infects the target for [FFAE00]2 turns[-] when landing a counter.[-][/i]

While the hero has the [00D5FF]Dark Veil[-] effect, they gain [FFAE00]1 orb[-] in the Ultimate Move Gauge when using an Attack Skill.

When a [00D5FF]Demon ally[-] is assuming a Stance, the hero's final damage taken from counters and enemy skills decreases by [FFAE00]40%[-].

relique.description: Estarossa of [b]Love[/b]'s Holy Relic (Weapon).\n[DC143C]A sword forged between the eleven-streamed Elivagar rivers. Its blade is infused with a mixture of many energies, as varied as the rivers' currents, and those who face it are said to have their minds warped.[-]

passif.description: For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Demon ally[-] participating in battle, their [00D5FF]damage taken[-] decreases by [FFAE00]20%[-].\n\nWhile the hero is assuming a Stance, their Attack-related stats increase by [FFAE00]30%[-] and all enemies' Defense-related stats decrease by [FFAE00]20%[-].
